THE BREAKTHROUGH

9 HP. One finished climb.

On run #182, Jev defeated Aeonglass, collected rewards at 9 HP, and completed The Architect ending. The game’s saved history confirms the victory.

A result we almost missed.

The ending reported 0 HP, so our monitor initially labeled it a loss. The native win: true record corrected it. This archive uses the game’s saved outcomes.

Sources, definitions & limitations

This is a frozen snapshot through the first victory on September 23, 2026. Outcomes come from 182 native game-history records, reconciled with 182 Jev sessions. Highest floor, decisions and policy versions come from the decision logs. The untouched A1 run and offline simulations are excluded. All times are shown in America/New_York.

“Logged decisions” counts decision entries, not individual model calls. A run can span several policy versions. Strategy dates are first observed live use unless labeled as a report date. Rolling averages include the selected run and its preceding nine runs. Day groups use the date of the first logged decision. Different random runs, evolving card unlocks, occasional manual recovery, and changing policies mean this is observational progress—not a controlled comparison or a current-policy win-rate estimate.

Only summarized gameplay data is included. Credentials, account IDs, game seeds and raw request logs are excluded.
